I wasted $300 on 5 tick repellents so you don't have to. Let me be more specific. Over the last year, I tried five different ways to keep ticks off my family. All five failed. In five different ways. It started small. Just the normal stuff you'd expect living in the suburbs near some woods. A tick on the dog. A tick on my son's sock. Nothing that felt urgent. Then, this spring, it started feeling less normal. My daughter came back from soccer practice with one behind her ear.
